story.title: The Ghost Painter
story.logline: A blind street artist discovers his hands paint the future disasters of passersby, until he paints his own.
story.twist: He was never painting the future; he was painting the people who had already died in his presence.
story.ending: Why are you standing so still in my canvas?

scenes.narration: My blindness is a lie because I see tomorrow bleeding through my fingertips on this cold concrete.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, a 20-year-old blind artist with messy dark hair wearing a worn denim jacket, painting frantically on a sidewalk.

scenes.narration: A laughing woman drops her coffee, but my charcoal already shows her broken umbrella beneath a falling sign.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 20, dark hair, denim jacket, on the sidewalk, listening intently while touching his drawing.

scenes.narration: I grab her sleeve and scream for her to step back, but she laughs it off as crazy art.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 20, dark hair, denim jacket, grabbing a woman's arm in a crowded urban street.

scenes.narration: The heavy iron sign crashes exactly where she stood a second ago, shattering the ceramic cup.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 20, dark hair, denim jacket, covering his ears amidst debris on a gray sidewalk.

scenes.narration: Every stroke I make steals a life from the dark and hands it back to cruel reality.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 20, dark hair, denim jacket, wiping sweat from his forehead on the sidewalk.

scenes.narration: Tonight, alone in my studio, my brush moves faster, sketching a lonely figure surrounded by flickering candles.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 20, dark hair, denim jacket, sketching rapidly in a dimly lit brick studio.

scenes.narration: I trace the fine lines of the face and realize the charcoal is leaving a wet, crimson stain.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 20, dark hair, denim jacket, touching wet red paint on his canvas in the dark studio.

scenes.narration: It is not ink or paint. It is warm, and it smells unmistakably of my own copper blood.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 20, dark hair, denim jacket, staring down at his bleeding hands in the dim studio.

scenes.narration: I turn around slowly, feeling the cold draft of an empty room that should have no doors.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 20, dark hair, denim jacket, turning around in the shadowy studio.

scenes.narration: Why are you standing so still in my canvas?
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 20, dark hair, denim jacket, staring directly into the camera lens with wide eyes.

caption.title: The Ghost Painter
caption.caption:
Blind to the world, he thought he was warning humanity of their impending fates. But every canvas revealed a ghost, already walking among the living.

Can you ever outrun the final stroke?
